title: fanout_firm_queue item (FanOutFirmQueue)
description: Firms with ready work per priority, for deficit round-robin (FW-013). DISENO S4 (c).
$comment: Table fanout_firm_queue (per cell). PK = FQ#<priority>, SK = FIRM#<firmId>. AP-F2: Query FQ#<priority> and weighted deficit round-robin. No TTL documented.

readyCount.description: Ready tasks of the firm in this priority.

deficit.description: Deficit counter of the weighted round-robin.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Constant ACTIVE; the item is deleted when readyCount = 0. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
